title: wg: ext-10 §4.7 'can be followed by' GCE/AppDataUpdate order
description: mls-extensions-10 §4.7 says a GroupContextExtensions proposal 'can be followed by' AppDataUpdate proposals. Unclear whether this is an ordering rule for proposals in a Commit or a description; processing order is set separately. OpenMLS enforces GCE-first (IncorrectOrder) and its own comment calls the rule unclear. Ask the editors to say which. mimid reads it strictly (decision mimid-1wgh.4.66).
